acceptance_criteria: bootstrap.sh and `scripts/site/zola.sh build` succeed on macOS arm64 under /bin/bash 3.2 and on Linux CI, SHA verified on both.
close_reason: zola.sh runs under bash 3.2 with shasum, all v0.22.0 unix digests pinned and verified; CI covers ubuntu and macos (PR #5)
